title: Case authorization fact (T15, spec 17.4)
description: Machine-readable authorization fact for one case. Lives at work/<case>/auth-profile.json next to scope.md. skills/scripts/verify-auth-profile.py enforces every rule below with the standard library: proof present, unexpired, non-empty target allowlist, action in scope, dangerous actions human-confirmed, filesystem/network egress declared and consistent with network_profile.mode, all numeric limits present and positive. No defaults are ever filled in: a missing field exits 20 (blocked), never silently passes.

case_id.description: Must equal scope.md meta case_id; a foreign file never matches.

approver.description: Human (or role id) that granted the authorization. Identity itself is enforced by the approval process; this record carries the claim the gate checks.

expires_at.description: UTC RFC 3339 expiry. expires_at <= now exits 20 (expired).

target_allowlist.description: Empty allowlist exits 20. Every ACT target must be covered by this list.

allowed_actions.description: Action vocabulary is open, but the gate's DANGEROUS set always needs human confirmation.

evidence_reference.description: Ticket, contract path, or preset receipt proving the grant. Placeholder values (FILL_ME, TODO, none, null) exit 20.

revocation_status.description: Any other value (revoked, suspended, missing) exits 20.

network_egress_allowlist.description: Must be empty when scope network_profile.mode is offline; otherwise every entry must resolve inside target_allowlist.

human_confirmations.description: Map of dangerous action -> {by, at}. A dangerous --action without an entry exits 20.
